freshDispositions.title: drop reasoning items OpenAI cannot read from Responses requests
freshDispositions.decision: Defer selective hardening; no required current repair established
freshDispositions.mechanics: Final Responses sanitizer runs after same-format encoding, so raw preservation does not bypass it. It drops reasoning with absent/null/empty encrypted_content when store is already false, always drops recognized Switchyard Anthropic-thinking envelopes, and preserves nonempty native OpenAI ciphertext.
freshDispositions.relevance: The motivating Claude-to-GPT stage route is inactive in the all-native template. Router already has separate substituted-caller stateless cleanup. This upstream filter is not present in the ordered local patches.
freshDispositions.integrationCaveat: Upstream checks store before defaults and the Router patch's body_overrides. An unchanged backport can miss invalid reasoning when the caller omits store or sets true and the target later forces false. If adopted, inspect the effective outbound store value while preserving valid opaque native ciphertext.
